in_hebrew.name: Prue
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Prue הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Middle English word 'pruet', meaning 'to try'. The name Prue was used in the 17th century as a diminutive of the name Philippa, which means 'lover of horses'. In the Bible, there is a character named Prue, who is one of the three sisters mentioned in the book of Ruth.
